Burger — manual test fixtures

Load the extension unpacked, then open each fixture and verify the expected outcome described in the page.

Positive (should reorder)

  • positive-basic.html — country select, US to top
  • positive-preserves-selection.html — selection preserved
  • positive-duplicate-value.html — duplicate values keep selected element
  • positive-dynamic.html — async-inserted country select
  • positive-currency.html — USD to top
  • positive-aria-country.html — ARIA combobox, country
  • positive-aria-currency.html — ARIA combobox, currency
  • positive-aria-rerender.html — ARIA listbox re-render reapply
  • positive-aria-hidden-open.html — open via hidden attribute
  • positive-pushstate.html — SPA pushState inject
  • positive-shadow-dom.html — <select> inside open shadow DOM

Phase 3: library coverage

Hand-written DOM matching real library output (Radix, Headless UI, MUI, Ant Design) and real CDN-loaded libraries (Select2, Choices.js, Tom Select, React Select). Verifying that ARIA / native / wrapped-select adapters cover them.

  • positive-radix.html — Radix UI Select pattern
  • positive-headlessui.html — Headless UI Listbox pattern
  • positive-mui-select.html — MUI Select (portal-rendered)
  • positive-antd.html — Ant Design Select (synth-role)
  • positive-select2.html — real Select2 (CDN)
  • positive-choices.html — real Choices.js (CDN)
  • positive-tom-select.html — real Tom Select (CDN)
  • positive-react-select.html — real React Select v5 (CDN)
